title: Lowest Common Ancestor of Deepest Leaves
description: Find the lowest common ancestor of the deepest leaves in a binary tree.

steps.note: Starting DFS traversal on the tree with structure: 1 -> (2, 3)
DFS reaches node 2. Both children are null, depth is 1.
DFS reaches node 3. Both children are null, depth is 1.
Back at node 1. Left depth (1) equals right depth (1). Return current node 1 as LCA.
